description: The SynD authors publish an early generator for synthetic household power-consumption data. The linked article describes a custom simulation using real appliance power traces to produce aggregate and individual-appliance series for residential non-intrusive load-monitoring research. The archived generator is separate from the already catalogued generated SynD data. Figshare supplies one ZIP descriptor under CC0. This tool can prepare synthetic electricity-demand inputs and benchmarks for building-energy and load-disaggregation modelling. The article describes a 180-day generated dataset; that example does not impose a fixed generator duration or geographic population. Coverage is a generic residential electricity-generation workflow, with no fixed geographic population. Access is public and free under the deposit licence. The native description calls this an early version. Programming language, interface, required dependencies and parameter controls are not specified in the inspected metadata. A limitation is that no code, archive, template traces or generated observations were read or executed. Published comparisons concern the associated dataset and do not establish accuracy for every generator setting.
